xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex66042023-09-26-110525" status="unreviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (81a4–81a5)"/><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5149"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3727">byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa</rs>'i rgyan</rs> zhes bya ba 'di ni | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3977"> byang chub <lb n="81a5"/> sems dpa' chen po 'phyims nam mkha' grags</rs> <?oxy_comment_start comment="P1060"?><?oxy_comment_end?> yab sras kyi byin bslab ° zhugs pa'i <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4221">skyi ston 'jam pa'i dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan</rs> gyis 'grel pa<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">mkhan po</rs> lnga dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">gtsang pa</rs> lasogs pa'i legs bshad rnams blangs | nyes bshad rnams dor nas | <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5733">dpal ldan <expan>sa skya</expan>'i gtsug lag chen po</rs>r sbyar ba'o ||</seg></TEI>
